title: Resolution Plan Schema v1
description: Versioned public output of the resolution-spine plan() function (keystone #2264 / epic #2203). The single source of truth every consumption context (init / update / doctor / headless) derives from. MUST stay in lockstep with @deftai/directive-types resolution.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version tag stamped into every plan.

files.description: Files the plan recommends materialising (empty in the keystone spine).

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisories (loud skew deltas, legacy-tree hints, reconciliation mismatches).

ResolutionMode.description: The one recommended resolution mode. plan() emits exactly one.

command.description: Command to run, or null when the action is manual / has no single command.
